notes.title: Visual Novel mode beta now available (version 1.0.6)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6412349/9763255398595380b3dd561a594778da00955e95.jpg
To celebrate the 3rd anniversary of this game release, I've added a new beta branch with a version of the game in "visual novel mode".

If you don't like the scheduler/stat raising gameplay and just want to experience the story, or if you have already finished the game once and want to quickly replay it to see the other endings, this is the right option.

You'll be able to skip the stat raising part completely and only enjoy the story.

To try the beta, right click on the game name in the library and choose "Betas" tab. Then select the beta. The game will update to version 1.0.6 with the new mode (will appear in the game after the usual intro).

For now this version is still in beta even if I think it should be working. Once enough people confirmed that they can reach all the endings, will move into the full release branch.
